children: On September 25, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock is subject to delisting for failing to maintain the minimum $1.00 bid price for 30 consecutive business days under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) and is ineligible for a compliance period due to a recent reverse stock split. Nasdaq will suspend trading on October 6, 2026, and file a Form 25 unless appealed by October 2, 2026; the company does not intend to appeal and anticipates trading on an OTC market.
